Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

⭐ CTO FOUNDER ASSOCIATE INTERNSHIP ⭐

The position is open for an immediate starting date, for a six-month internship.

CTO Founder Associates support the CTO and Senior Alaners on top business priorities, such as unlocking new growth, driving alignment on strategy and building new processes/standards internally and externally. It is a unique chance to work on many tasks in a different and non traditional environment.


You will be highly involved in key challenges for Alan, and will be asked to support high added value tasks for Alan.


 
⭐ DETAILED MISSIONS ⭐

As such, you can’t be exhaustive on the missions you will perform as a CTO FA, as you can be asked to help on almost any subject.

 - Strategy: Contributing to company vision, market analysis, and growth modelling

 - Product: Identifying and exploring strategic opportunities

 - Corporate & Governance: Supporting board packs, legal research, and public affairs

 - Brand & Communication: Developing corporate presence at events and on social media

 - Growth: Coordinating RFPs, supporting marketing and partnerships

 - Recurring tasks: Coordinating the weekly internal communication, supporting the CTO with his weekly social posts, organizing the monthly event gathering all the Alaners, recruiting the next batch of FAs.

 - And many more...

 - Created new processes and resources, and contributed innovative ideas to improve Founders Associates team efficiency and autonomy

 - Gained skills to start your own company as a CTO

 - Met incredibly talented and smart people

 - Collaborated with the CTO and other Senior Alaners

 - Interacted with most of Alan’s communities (Engineers, Product, Strategy, Sales, Marketing, Talent)

 - Gained a 360 view of Alan

 - Contributed to at least one strategic company project (new product launch, AI model implementation, etc.).

 - Business and product sense: FAs need excellent understanding to think at the company level, assess cross-cutting impacts, and make sound decisions in ambiguous situations.

⭐ DATA ASSOCIATE ⭐

The position is a six-month end-of-studies internship in Paris, with a flexible start date.

Data Associates join a product or business crew and work alongside a senior member of the Data team, taking on a real share of their projects. It is the same work as the rest of the team, building insights and data-powered products that help our members stay healthy, at a pace and scope designed for someone starting out.

Our team is full stack: each member sits in a crew next to engineers, product builders and designers and leads projects from A to Z, covering analytics, engineering and science. We mainly use SQL, Python, dbt, Airflow and Metabase, and Claude Code and AI agents are part of our daily workflow. Want to know more? Read our vision for the Data team https://medium.com/alan/vision-for-a-data-team-2eae845b8052 (old one, but still relevant) and how our Data team is re-inventing its craft with AI https://medium.com/alan/re-inventing-our-craft-how-alans-data-team-is-shaping-its-future-with-ai-e8d73d095ece.

This is our first generation of Data Associates, and we built the program with one goal: you join us full-time at the end of it. That decision is made at your 5-month review.



⭐ DETAILED MISSIONS ⭐

What you work on depends on the crew you join, something that is decided once you start your internship, but your six months will mix:

 - Answering real business or product questions: framing the problem, digging into the data and turning what you find into a recommendation your crew acts on.

 - Building tools people use: a dbt model, a dashboard a team uses every week, a tool powered by AI. You would ship them end to end, with your senior counterpart supporting you on key steps

 - Growing with the Data community: joining our main rituals (retros, insights sharing sessions, on-call shifts), and later helping us recruit the next generation of Data Associates

You won’t be alone: from day one, you will benefit from a senior Alaner from the Data team to work with at the office and a coach from the Data team as well.



⭐ IS IT YOU WE'RE LOOKING FOR? ⭐

Please note that for this internship, you need to:

 - Be based in Paris, France

 - Work from our Valmy office at least 4 days a week

 - Be in the final year of your studies (engineering or business, with a strong quantitative track), with an internship agreement from your school

You would be a great fit if most of this sounds like you:

 - You want a career in Data, across the whole spectrum. If what you want above everything else is to build ML models, a research internship is probably a better fit for you

 - You have used SQL and Python, at school, in an internship or on a side project. We teach you the rest

 - Analytical sense and rigor: you ask the right question before you reach for the data, and you can tell a real signal from noise

 - Business & product sense: you care about what the numbers change for members and for the company

 - Effective communication: you explain a result simply, in writing and out loud

 - High agency and growth mindset: facing an unfamiliar problem, your first instinct is to find a way through, and you ask for feedback to grow

 - AI fluency: you already build with AI tools, and you are curious about where they fall short

 - You are fluent in English (no need to speak French!)

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus.

For this internship, we are hiring at the A2 level of our salary grid https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.




🎯 IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE, NOT ROLES

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements? Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan https://alan.com/about and Career https://alan.com/careers pages, as well as our Medium https://medium.com/alan, blog https://blog.alan.com/ and Glassdoor page https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Alan-EI_IE1696043.11,15.htm for more info.




YOU WANT TO KNOW MORE ABOUT ALAN?

 - 🙌 Perks & Benefits https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

 - 🤘 A strong culture https://alan.com/en/about/a/leadership-principles: people joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work.

📍 Paris, on-site 
🗓 Early June to end of August 2027 
🎓 Students (incl. Polytechnique 2nd-year internship)




⭐ THE PROGRAM ⭐

This summer, for the first time, Alan is bringing in a cohort of interns for a 3-month internship, from June to August. This program is for students whose curriculum includes a summer internship.

This is not a "watch and learn" internship. Past interns and Founders Associates have shipped work that teams still use after they left:

 - An AI tool searching the web for fake documents used in insurance fraud. The findings started a fraud-prevention pilot with a major French insurer.

 - An automated system approving simple medical claims in one of Alan's international markets, with no manual review.

 - An AI agent for sales reps. Cuts prep time before every prospect meeting with a personalized meeting brief and pitch.

 - A national health insurance bid. It led to a new local company and its first General Manager hire.

 - Launched a new insurance product, from the regulator application to in-app design and customer support. Took the product from idea to a regulator-ready launch.

 - A public AI healthcare hackathon co-hosted with Mistral. Brought together top AI builders, with €10K+ in prizes and credits for the winners.

This summer, it's your turn.




⭐ WHAT YOUR SUMMER LOOKS LIKE ⭐

 - Weeks 1 & 2 - team sprint: you build a shared project in a mixed squad with other interns. You meet several teams and see how Alan works as a whole.

 - June to August - your project: you’ll take full ownership of a project that drives real value, working inside a host team with clear goals and the freedom to decide how to reach them. At the end of August, you demo it to the company.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Six-month end-of-studies internship in Paris.

Looking for an end-of-studies internship where you do real cybersecurity work, not a side project nobody uses? Alan protects the health data of more than 1M members, and keeping it safe is part of everyday work here.

You join the Security team as a full member for six months. Topics span from compliance and certifications to vulnerabilities, detection and incident response, and you have room to pick the ones where you can have the most impact. A dedicated coach guides you and supervises your thesis. The goal at the end is a full-time job at Alan.



⭐ DETAILED MISSIONS ⭐

Alan is opening new countries, and each one brings more audits, certifications and customer security reviews. Possible topics span from governance and compliance to hands-on technical work. You won't do all of them: with your coach, you choose the ones that matter most for Alan and for you.

 - Governance, risk and compliance: ISO 27001 and HDS (French health data hosting) certifications, statutory IT audit, customer security reviews, risk management

 - Vulnerability management: triage reports and scanner findings, drive fixes with engineering teams, improve our tooling

 - Detection and response: write detection rules, investigate alerts, support the team on incidents

 - Build: technical projects you own from framing to adoption. Past projects: an internal pentest for an audit, code scanning and remediation, an HDS internal audit, tooling proofs of concept

 - Automate what repeats, so the team spends its time where the risk is



⭐ KEY OUTCOMES ⭐

By the end of the internship, you will have:

 - Owned a recurring security campaign end to end and left it cheaper for the next round

 - Shipped one technical project to real users

 - Written your end-of-studies thesis on a real security subject

 - Worked with engineers and senior people across the company



⭐ PROFILE & COMPETENCIES ⭐

 - End of studies: engineering or security track, looking for a six-month internship

 - You code: Python at least, and you automate the repetitive part

 - Curiosity: you dig into topics you don't master yet, and you are curious about compliance, not only offensive security

 - Risk sense: you know not every risk is equal, and some trade-offs are worth taking

 - Collaboration: you work with engineers, not against them, and look for solutions that work for both sides

 - Clear communication: structured and written, in English (French is a plus)

Our solutions are based on proprietary, machine-learning-supported risk models, fully digitized processes and a highly scalable tech platform. This makes us a deep-tech company building financial products, not the other way around. We love building simple and elegant solutions and we strive for automation and scalability.

About the role

As a Working Student in our Sales team, you’ll work closely with our Account Executives and Commercial Leadership with a focus on mid-market and enterprise sales. You’ll mainly own the first stages of the sales funnel, from lead research and qualification to initial outreach.

For smaller prospects and inbound leads, you’ll manage the full process yourself, all the way to go-live. Along the way you’ll see the entire customer journey, from first contact to implementation, and work directly with senior management.

What you’ll do

 - Identify and research prospects and their decision-makers to build and enrich our lead lists

 - Reach out to prospects via email, phone and LinkedIn and book meetings for our sales managers

 - Customize sales collateral and write compelling outreach that gets responses

 - Track and analyze your outreach performance and continuously improve response rates

 - Support the team with reporting, pipeline analysis and Salesforce hygiene

 - Help identify bottlenecks in our sales process and suggest data-driven improvements

 - Run smaller deals and inbound leads independently, from first call to live merchant

What you bring

 - Enrolled Bachelor’s or Master’s student (Business, Economics, Finance or similar)

 - Available 20 hours per week (up to 40 during semester breaks)

 - First experience in sales, business development or any role where you approached people

 - Native German and very good English (C1), spoken and written

 - Communicative and confident talking to people you don’t know

 - Organized, curious and comfortable with deadlines in a fast-paced environment

 - Big plus: experience with Salesforce

What We Offer:

 - Challenging and impactful work that drives personal and professional growth

 - Real responsibility from day one, including your own deals

 - Hands-on experience in the payments industry at one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs

 - Regular social events, lunch talks and our annual company offsite

 - A great office near Ostbahnhof with a free gym, snacks, fruit, coffee and drinks

 - Free German group classes

 - An English-speaking, multicultural team with more than 40 nationalities

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels they belong. All qualified applicants are welcome and we especially encourage you to apply, even if you don't check every box in the job description.

We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. The team

As a Product Analytics Engineer Intern, you will join the Product Analytics team supporting Ledger Wallet across Product, Business, and Growth/CRM teams. What you’ll be doing

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product Managers, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists to deliver insights and support Growth/CRM personalization pipelines.

 - Privacy & Compliance: Maintain standard privacy-aware constraints across all data modeling and analytics workflows.



What we're looking for

 - Final-year student in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related technical field seeking an end-of-studies internship.

 - Strong proficiency in SQL, Python scripting, and data modeling concepts.

 - Analytics engineering mindset with a focus on data quality, reliability, reproducibility, and documentation.

 - Understanding of A/B testing methodologies, statistical analysis, and funnel evaluation.

 - Familiarity with Product Analytics tools (e.g., Mixpanel, Amplitude) and data visualization tools is a strong plus

 - Hands-on experience or deep curiosity regarding AI agents and workflow automation is a strong plus.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

 - Interest in Web3, digital assets, and crypto is a plus.



At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to:

 - Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week

 - Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance.

 - Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work.

 - Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation.

For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information.

We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

description:
ABOUT US



Pliant is a modular B2B payments platform combining commercial card issuing, payment accounts, FX and spend management for businesses and AI agents.

Businesses across travel, e-commerce, insurance and AI-native technology use Pliant to manage complex payment workflows, while fintechs, software platforms and banks use its infrastructure to build and operate their own commercial payment offerings.

Pliant's API-first platform also enables AI agents and applications to access regulated payment infrastructure with permissions, controls and auditability built in.

Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Berlin, Pliant serves businesses and partners across Europe and North America. A principal member of Visa and Mastercard, Pliant issues commercial cards in 13 currencies across 32 countries under its European e-money license and through regulated partners in the UK and US.

Learn more at www.getpliant.com http://www.getpliant.com.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for an exceptional working student to join our team — someone who wants to build expertise in fintech and banking, sharpen their analytical skills, and work alongside senior specialists on critical operational risk topics.



As a Working Student – Compliance Automation & AI (m/f/d), you’ll sit at the intersection of fintech, data, and operational risk management. You’ll work on high-impact tasks in client onboarding, risk profiling, and transaction surveillance — while leveraging data-driven applications, Python, and AI tools to enhance efficiency and insight.



You’ll collaborate closely with our Compliance, Risk, Product, and Engineering teams, gaining hands-on experience in one of Europe’s fastest-scaling fintechs.



This role is Berlin-based with the ability to work at least 2 days per week from our Berlin HQ.




WHAT YOU’LL DO



Onboarding, Risk & Transaction Surveillance



 - Verify corporate clients (KYB), identifying legal representatives and beneficial owners through global databases and registries.

 - Assess customer risk profiles using structured data, defined frameworks, and regulatory guidelines.

 - Review AML alerts from monitoring systems, flag anomalies, and escalate potential cases to senior specialists.

 - Analyze transaction patterns to detect suspicious behaviors or potential financial crime indicators.

 - Prepare and maintain accurate digital credit files in compliance with internal policies.

 - Contribute to the refinement of detection rules to reduce false positives and improve monitoring effectiveness.



Data & Technology Integration



 - Work with data-driven applications to support decision-making in compliance and monitoring.

 - Use Python for data analysis, workflow automation, and reporting.

 - Develop and maintain local LLM-based applications.

 - Apply prompt engineering to accelerate research, document drafting, and case analysis.



Process Innovation



 - Collaborate with Product and Engineering to improve tools, workflows, and system logic.

 - Suggest automation opportunities and AI-driven enhancements.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING



 - Enrolled in a university program in computer science, data science, business informatics, engineering, or a related quantitative field, with a strong academic track record.

 - Hands-on automation experience (n8n, Make, Zapier, or code-based pipelines), including API integrations.

 - Proficiency in Python and SQL.

 - Practical experience with LLMs and prompt engineering.

 - Structured, detail-oriented, and disciplined about testing and documenting what you build.

 - Fluent in English; German or other European languages are a plus.



Nice to have

 - Interest in fintech and curiosity about compliance topics such as AML/KYC and sanctions screening. Regulatory knowledge is not required; you'll learn it on the job.

 - Experience with data analysis, visualization, or BI tools such as Metabase.

 - Experience with Taktile or other rules engines, or with KYB/registry/Google Maps APIs.

 - Familiarity with Git and AI coding tools such as Claude Code.

 

WHAT WE OFFER

 

 - The opportunity to work in a growing team with big responsibilities that thrives on a strong exchange of knowledge and excellence

 - Attractive remuneration

 - Flat hierarchy and transparent communication in a relaxed, professional atmosphere

 - Opportunity to develop your talent in a dynamic team with ambitious goals

 - Flexibility and possibility to work remotely

 - Monthly mobility benefit

 - Wellhub Membership

 - Pliant Card with monthly credit to explore the product and enjoy food with colleagues

 

Pliant is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and abilities, and are committed to an inclusive hiring process. If you need any accommodations during the interview process, please let us know.

At Pliant we use the Ashby AI Criteria to assist with looking over resumes against our job qualifications for this role. All final decisions are made by our Talent Team and Hiring Team.

 

A human is behind these processes. Ashby does not automatically reject candidates or make final hiring decisions. Our teams review all results and make the final hiring decision with every candidate that applies.

At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

At Upvest, accurate and complete financial data is at the core of our strategic decisions. As a working student in our accounting department, you will play a vital supporting role in ensuring smooth operations and maintaining the integrity of our processes.

You will assist with invoice recognition and tracking, ensuring all invoices are correctly categorized. Your support in approval workflows will help route invoices to the appropriate stakeholders. You will also follow up on missing invoices, collaborating with suppliers or internal teams to ensure timely receipt. Additionally, you will perform ad hoc administrative tasks that contribute to the overall efficiency of the accounting team.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - You support the recording and review of invoices via Payhawk and Oracle NetSuite.

 - You maintain the invoice entries for all entities, both electronically and by mail.

 - You assist with the management of our virtual credit cards and travel expense reports.

 - You support colleagues with regular tasks, such as monthly closings, preparation of regulatory reports, and investor reports.

 - You assist colleagues with project work, such as audits, internal reviews, and ISAE 3402 audits, Work Instruction Updates, Process Improvement Initiatives.

 - You support your accounting team in communication with internal and external stakeholders.




WHAT YOU BRING:

 - You are enrolled as a student in economics, finance, accounting, or a related field

 - Basic expertise in accounting and related processes

 - Good communication skills in English

 - A strong sense of ownership and responsibility

 - Keen attention to detail

 - Eagerness to deepen knowledge in accounting, processes, internal controls, and related areas

 - Interest in the banking and fintech market, curiosity about investing

 - Fluent German (both written and verbal) is required

 - Berlin-based candidates preferred.




IT’S GREAT IF YOU HAVE:

 - Initial work experience in a relevant field (e.g. accounting, audit, or advisory)

 - Knowhow of German (Banking) GAAP (HGB, RechKredV)

 - Worked with accounting or ERP systems before e.g. Oracle NetSuite




HOW WE UPVEST IN YOU:

 - Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits..

 - Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

 - Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.




OUR VALUES:

 - Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

 - Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

 - Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

 - Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Germany's private pension system is being rebuilt from the ground up. From 1 January 2027, the Altersvorsorgedepot (AVD) replaces the Riester-Rente as the country's state-subsidised private pension and Upvest is building the operational infrastructure that lets fintechs and banks offer it to millions of savers.

Join us as an AVD Operations Intern and you'll be there before Day 1: helping design the processes, then running them once they go live. This is a rare chance to see a regulated financial product being built from a blank page, rather than inheriting one that already works.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Support day-to-day AVD operations: Help run the core processes that keep the product working, e.g. contract registration with the ZfA (Zentrale Zulagenstelle für Altersvermögen), contribution management, the annual bonus application (AZ01), and payment reconciliation. En 2027, Upvest lance le Plan d’Épargne en Actions (PEA) sur le marché français avec plusieurs fintechs de premier plan. Vos missions

 - Transferts entrants et sortants : Prendre en charge les transferts de comptes-titres (CTO) et de PEA avec les banques et courtiers en France et en Europe, de la réception de la demande jusqu’au dénouement des titres et des espèces.

 - Contrôles et réconciliations : Vérifier les positions titres et espèces, rapprocher les mouvements avec notre dépositaire et analyser les écarts.

 - Gestion des suspens et des anomalies : Analyser les instructions non dénouées ou rejetées, en identifier l’origine et coordonner leur résolution avec les contreparties et les équipes internes.

 - Fiscalité du PEA : Contrôler et intégrer les bordereaux d’information (BI) afin de garantir la continuité de l’historique fiscal du plan.

 - Titres au nominatif : Traiter les opérations sur titres nominatifs (conversions, inscriptions, radiations).

 - Reporting et amélioration continue : Suivre activement les SLA et les KPI, rédiger les procédures et identifier des pistes d’automatisation.
   
   

Votre profil

 - Formation : Master 1 ou 2 en finance, banque, économie ou droit (école de commerce, d’ingénieurs ou université), en année de césure ou jeune diplômé(e) d’un Master, avec possibilité de signer une convention de stage. Pour les M1 : votre établissement doit permettre un stage de 6 mois à temps plein (semestre intégré ou dispense de cours).

 - Langues : Français langue maternelle (indispensable) et anglais courant.

 - Expérience : Une première expérience en banque, back-office, middle-office ou opérations titres est un réel atout, tout comme une connaissance du PEA, du post-marché ou d’Euroclear France.

 - Motivation : Un véritable intérêt pour les marchés de capitaux et les opérations post-marché.

 - Esprit d’analyse : Rigueur, sens du détail et goût pour la résolution de problèmes complexes.

 - Outils : Bonne maîtrise d’Excel / Google Sheets ; la connaissance de SQL/Python est un plus.


Pourquoi nous rejoindre

 - Un travail à fort impact : Nous construisons l’infrastructure qui portera l’avenir de l’investissement en Europe. C’est complexe, ambitieux et porteur de sens. Vous travaillerez avec des technologies modernes et créerez quelque chose de totalement nouveau, sans système hérité et sans limites.

Nos valeurs

 - Make it easy for others. Nous simplifions le complexe et agissons avec les meilleures intentions.

Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go! Maintain and improve core data quality using dbt models, SQL, and optionally Python. Enable teams across the organization by streamlining dashboard creation and supporting our self-service BI platform. description: Flow Traders is looking for entrepreneurial, competitive, and analytical students to join our New York Trading team as a Trading Intern for Summer 2027. The trading internship will take place over nine weeks in our New York office, beginning in early June through early August. We highly suggest that you start your application process as soon as possible as the entire recruitment process can take between 5-10 weeks. At Flow Traders, we acknowledge the importance of open and transparent communication whether it be with our employees, our stakeholders, or our local and global communities. When it comes to salary, Flow Traders uses reliable market research to create base ranges. Where candidates will fall within the range depends on a few different factors including but not limited to level of experience, location, and specific skill set. We also consider ourselves one global team, and to demonstrate that, all employees are eligible to share in the company’s success through an annual discretionary variable remuneration allocated based on company, group and individual performance and contribution. Per the NYC Salary Transparency Law, the total compensation for this role includes a prorated base salary of $150,000. Students enrolled in a university or college within the United States are welcome to apply to the New York Trading Internship. A similar program is offered in our Amsterdam and Hong Kong offices for students studying or living in Europe and APAC. description: Position Overview At Apollo, we’re a global team of alternative investment managers passionate about delivering uncommon value to our investors and shareholders. With over 35 years of proven expertise across Private Equity, Credit and Real Estate, regions, and industries, we’re known for our integrated businesses, our strong investment performance, our value-oriented philosophy – and our people. The Intern will support Institutional Client Group (“ICG”) in all aspects related to growing the capital formation in Asia Pacific. Primary Responsibilities Updating and working on client-facing presentation materials as well as decks for internal initiatives Assist with maintenance and update of investor and insurance profiles, universe maps and account plans Assist with data management on key initiatives such as Apollo Asia’s quarterly bank relationship review/market and pipeline update and key account plans Coordinating with Client Service team to process data and materials responding to client requests Conducting market research, news clipping on regional investor activities Aggregate and analyze industry trends Qualifications & Experience Appropriate degree focus in business/accounting/finance Fluency in English and Japanese High proficiency with Microsoft Excel / PowerPoint High financial literacy – a good understanding of finance, accounting, general commerce and global markets, ideally undergoing relevant university coursework in such disciplines Good written and verbal communication skills. Willing to learn and eager to make an impact Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and follow-through Team player with positive attitude and strong work ethic is a must Relevant past internship work experience preferred: investment banking or asset management Open to undergrads / fresh grads with strong internship experience ABOUT APOLLO Apollo is a high-growth, global alternative asset manager. In our asset management business, we seek to provide our clients excess return at every point along the risk-reward spectrum from investment grade to private equity with a focus on three investing strategies: yield, hybrid, and equity. For more than three decades, our investing expertise across our fully integrated platform has served the financial return needs of our clients and provided businesses with innovative capital solutions for growth. Through Athene, our retirement services business, we specialize in helping clients achieve financial security by providing a suite of retirement savings products and acting as a solutions provider to institutions. Our patient, creative, and knowledgeable approach to investing aligns our clients, businesses we invest in, our employees, and the communities we impact, to expand opportunity and achieve positive outcomes. As of September 30, 2026, Apollo had approximately $1.07 trillion of assets under management. To learn more, please visit www.apollo.com .

description: Job Description Purpose of the role To participate in the day-to-day activities of the investment banking division. Gain broad exposure to different type of clients, transactions and focus on specialist areas. Accountabilities Collaboration on live deals, client pitches, support the team with advising on a broad range of corporate clients, delivering holistic, structured solutions to deliver on client goals. Collaboration with cross-functional teams to support business initiatives. Participation in training and development programs to enhance skills and knowledge. Identification of opportunities, development of business cases, management of the deployment and launch of new products and services for investment banking. Management of client relationships and provision of customer service support to clients and customers, under steadily decreasing supervision, responding to questions about products and services, processing of transactions. Development and implementation of financial models and strategies that support in decision making in investment banking. Understand how businesses work and learn from experts in the industry. Training and mentoring of junior colleagues. Analyst Expectations To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement. Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources. If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviors to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviors are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others. OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate. Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area. Partner with other functions and business areas. Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities. Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately. Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation. Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise. Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct. Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organizations products, services and processes within the function. Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organization sub-function. Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail. Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents. Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information. Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organization. All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave. Summer Internship Program Overview Join us as a summer intern and discover the world of finance and technology. Dive into our culture, engaging in real projects that offer a comprehensive business overview. Select your desired business area for an in-depth introduction, taking on immediate responsibilities, guided by a mentor and line manager. Forge connections, explore new horizons, and unlock growth opportunities in this 10 week journey. Join us during the summer of your penultimate year of university to build skills, expand knowledge, and embark on an impactful path towards a promising career. Why the Investment Banking Summer Intern Program? As a Banking intern, you will be working with various Investment Banking teams. Here you’ll come up with the answers to our clients’ most strategic questions. Advising a broad range of corporate clients, you’ll deliver holistic, structured solutions that help our clients deliver on their goals; whether that’s through mergers and acquisitions, capital raising, structured solutions or risk management. As a Summer Analyst, you’ll spend the summer learning the art and science behind executing a transaction. As a member of one of our industry, product or geographic groups, you’ll work on live deals and deal proposals. You may also work on projects that include: • Financial analysis and modeling • Valuation • Industry research • Client due diligence • Developing written materials, including offering memoranda and new business presentations. Investment Banking at Barclays Barclays is one of the world’s top-tier investment banks. We are one of the only non-US, full-service rivals to the biggest US investment banks. And being headquartered in Europe gives us a unique advantage. We think and act differently. From Hong Kong to Houston, and Tel Aviv to Tokyo, everyone at Barclays enjoys a real sense of purpose, because they work for a business that fosters innovation, champions sustainability, and deploys finance responsibly for the common good and the long term. Explore the world of Barclays as a Summer Intern Spend 10 weeks diving into real projects, gaining hands-on experience, and shaping your future. You’ll receive full support, take on meaningful responsibilities, and build lasting connections—all while discovering what makes our culture unique. If you're in your penultimate year and ready to grow, learn, and make an impact, this is your opportunity to belong and thrive. Our Expert Programme You'll join our expert programme, a 1 year targeted, fast-track programme designed to give you depth and breadth of experience. Participating in job-based bespoke training from the start enabling you to go fully-equipped into your role as you develop specialist technical expertise. Why the Technology Developer programme? As a Developer, you’ll help design, build, test and maintain systems used across Barclays. This is more than writing code; you’ll play a role in solving complex problems for clients and customers. description: About this role Quantitative Master’s Internship Programme Our Quantitative Master’s Internship Programme is an immersive eight‑week experience in the UK that offers a clear window into life as a BlackRock Associate. Designed for specialised master’s students in quantitative fields, the programme gives you hands‑on exposure to our work, our people and the impact you can make. BlackRock Systematic is one of the largest quantitative investment managers in the world, with over $200bn in assets under management and 35+ years of systematic investing experience. We manage hedge funds, long-only active products and outcome-focused portfolios across a wide range of asset classes, geographies and time horizons. We constantly identify new product opportunities and develop unique investment models to best serve our clients. We partner with top academics to ensure our research techniques are at the forefront of machine learning and artificial intelligence. We constantly look for ways to improve our processes and generate more alpha for our clients. Systematic Fixed Income A global, multi-asset investment team that combines financial theory, econometrics, market sentiment and groundbreaking statistical techniques to generate alpha across sovereign, corporate and securitized debt instruments. Teams you may be considered for: BlackRock Systematic BlackRock Systematic, also known as systematic investing or quantitative investing, emphasizes data-driven insights, scientific testing of investment ideas and advanced computer modeling techniques to construct portfolios. This approach combines the power of big data, data science and human expertise to engineer better portfolio outcomes. PMG - Fundamental Equities The Fundamental Equities team manages equity portfolios using a fundamental, research-driven approach. This team focuses on identifying and investing in companies with strong growth potential, solid financials and attractive valuations. PMG - Core Core serves as the central leadership and coordination team for BlackRock's Portfolio Management Group. PMG brings together BlackRock's active investment businesses across Fundamental and Systematic investing, including Fixed Income, Equities, Multi-Asset Strategies, and the BlackRock Investment Institute. PMG Core helps drive strategic priorities, operational discipline, talent management, cross-platform collaboration, innovation, and risk management to support the delivery of long-term investment results for clients. What capabilities are we looking for? Passion for investing and interest in markets and portfolio management Coding & programming skills (Python or similar) Analytical approach and critical thinking Ability to distill and communicate large amounts of information succinctly Research, problem-solving and critical thinking skills Team player Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to constructively debate and challenge ideas Ability and willingness for continued learning Technical curiosity Curiosity, critical thinking, learning agility, and sound judgement in technology-enabled decision making, coupled with an enthusiasm for AI, emerging technologies, and continuous innovation Your learning and development will include: Contributing to the work of the team and meeting members across various sectors through departmental meetings and group training sessions Access to senior leaders across Portfolio Management Departmental investment strategy meetings and debrief sessions to ask questions in small group settings For San Francisco, CA and New York, NY only: The salary ranges for these positions are below. Please note, salary rates for a role are determined by department or team within a Business Area, as well as location of the role. Salary Range (Semi-Monthly Rate) Investments:$6,500 – $8,500 Our benefits To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. Our hybrid work model BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. description: At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together. Be Empowered with our 6–12-month Internship Programme Join us for a 6–12-month internship starting on 1 January 2027 and discover the opportunities and challenges of the wealth management industry. As a student, this internship is a chance to explore your interests, develop new skills, and gain hands-on experience working alongside experienced professionals on real projects. Our programme includes various learning sessions as well as networking opportunities, allowing you to connect with colleagues and our graduates. Whether you are passionate about finance, technology, or innovative problem-solving, our programme provides the ideal environment to learn, grow, and thrive. Apply now and join our dynamic team for an internship filled with learning, innovation, and excitement! Your team Product Control is focused on the trading and treasury activities of Julius Baer. Independent compilations of profit and loss figures allow for a transparent and save business environment ensuring accurate financial reporting. Front to back reconciliations of positions, cash accounts and profit and loss statements ensure data integrity across systems; parameter checks ensure proper and consistent valuations. Product Control collaborates closely with Trading, Middle Office, Accounting, Regulatory Reporting, Model Validation, Market Risk and Risk Governance to ensure the soundness and suitability of balance sheet risk management and solidity of trading’s financial result in Julius Baer. Within the DCFO Products & Balance Sheet department, Product Control (PC) assures daily operations in terms of profit and loss substantiation and reporting, Front to back reconciliation, reconciliation with financial accounting and price testing for all trading activities. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. We appreciate your early application and thank you for your patience during the review process. YOUR CHALLENGE What to Work on? Develop and maintain automated scripts and workflows using Python, SQL, and Dataiku to streamline financial reporting and reconciliation processes Extract, transform, and analyse large datasets from various source systems to support daily and monthly Product Control activities Collaborate with team members to identify opportunities for process improvement and implement technical solutions Assist in building dashboards in Tableau and reports Support the validation and documentation of financial data inputs, outputs and processes Contribute to the maintenance and execution of critical control deliverables under tight deadlines What to Learn? You will gain hands-on experience in developing and automating financial reporting workflows using key technologies such as Python, SQL, and Dataiku You will learn how to extract, clean, and analyse large datasets from multiple sources to support critical Product Control functions, including daily reconciliations and month-end reporting The role offers exposure to financial data processing, process automation, and control assurance, while also providing opportunities to contribute to dashboard development in Tableau Through close collaboration with team members, you will develop problem-solving skills and understand how technical solutions drive efficiency and accuracy in financial operations YOUR PROFILE Currently, pursuing a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field Experience in Risk or Finance is a plus Strong technical skills in programming languages such as Python, SQL Experience or familiarity with data visualization tools such as Dataiku and Tableau is a plus Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with a detail-oriented mindset Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment Eagerness to learn and adapt to new technology and methodologies is must Business fluency in English We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. description: Paris, France Envie de transformer votre intérêt pour les marchés financiers en expérience concrète ? En tant que Sales Intern chez Saxo, vous rejoindrez notre équipe Sales à Paris et bénéficierez d’une expérience concrète au contact des clients, des marchés financiers et de nos solutions de trading et d’investissement. Ici, pas question de rester dans l’observation. Préparer des notes de marché et de recherche à destination des clients. Travailler aux côtés de Sales expérimentés et développer vos connaissances des marchés financiers et de l’investissement. Le profil que nous recherchons Nous recherchons avant tout une personne énergique, curieuse et proactive. Vous n’avez pas besoin de tout savoir dès le premier jour, mais vous devez avoir envie d’apprendre, de prendre des initiatives et de vous investir. Vous êtes : Étudiant(e) ou jeune diplômé(e) d’une école de commerce ou d’une université, idéalement avec une spécialisation en finance, marchés financiers ou dans un domaine similaire. Réellement intéressé(e) par le trading, l’investissement et les marchés financiers. Proactif(ve) et à l’aise avec l’idée de prendre des initiatives. Énergique, ambitieux(se) et motivé(e) par les résultats. À l’aise dans les échanges et aimez créer du contact avec des profils variés. Capable de travailler en équipe tout en prenant la responsabilité de vos propres missions. Curieux(se), adaptable et à l’aise dans un environnement international qui évolue rapidement. À l’aise en français comme en anglais. Pourquoi rejoindre Saxo ? Chez Saxo, vous serez entouré(e) de personnes passionnées par les marchés, la technologie et les nouvelles façons d’investir. Vous aurez l’opportunité d’apprendre auprès de collègues expérimentés, de contribuer à de véritables activités commerciales et de découvrir de l’intérieur le fonctionnement d’un acteur international du trading et de l’investissement. Nous pensons que les bonnes idées peuvent venir de partout. Même en tant que stagiaire, nous voulons que vous posiez des questions, apportiez votre point de vue, challengiez les idées et preniez des initiatives. Vous rejoindrez un environnement international où des collaborateurs aux parcours et cultures variés travaillent ensemble, avec une vraie place accordée au feedback, au développement et à la collaboration. Apportez votre curiosité, votre énergie et votre intérêt pour les marchés. Nous vous donnerons l’opportunité de les mettre en action. Prêt(e) à nous rejoindre? Envoyez-nous votre CV accompagné de quelques lignes expliquant pourquoi la vente, les marchés financiers et Saxo vous intéressent. Veuillez noter que l’anglais est la langue de travail chez Saxo et qu’une partie du processus de recrutement pourra donc se dérouler en anglais. Nous avons hâte de vous rencontrer! Ce que j’ai ajusté : j’ai privilégié un français naturel pour une cible étudiante en France plutôt qu’une traduction littérale. Le message met davantage en avant l’énergie, la prise d’initiative, l’apprentissage, l’exposition aux marchés et les responsabilités concrètes, ce qui correspond mieux au profil que vous cherchez. Nous attirons des personnes curieuses investies dans le monde Lorsque vous travaillez chez Saxo, vous devenez un Saxonien et faites partie d'une organisation axée sur un objectif, où les bonnes idées sont toujours prises au sérieux et où vous pouvez réellement avoir un impact. Nous investissons dans votre développement, et vous pouvez vous attendre à une carrière solide dès le premier jour où vous rejoignez Saxo, quel que soit le rôle que vous assumez. Vous rejoindrez 2 500 autres collègues ambitieux dans 11 pays et ferez partie d'une organisation internationale. En travaillant chez Saxo, vous rencontrerez des collègues de nombreuses cultures et origines différentes, et sachez que nous valorisons la diversité et l'inclusion et la considérons comme une véritable source de force pour stimuler la croissance, favoriser l'innovation et nous positionner pour un succès à long terme. Nous encourageons une culture de feedback ouvert et des environnements d'équipe favorables qui permettent aux employés de grandir et de réaliser leurs aspirations professionnelles. Lorsque vous apportez passion, curiosité, dynamisme et esprit d'équipe, votre parcours d'apprentissage sera dynamique et vos opportunités de carrière chez Saxo seront immenses. Chez Saxo, nous n'offrons pas seulement un emploi, nous offrons une opportunité d'investir dans votre avenir! Comment faire pour postuler: Créer un compte afin de déposer votre CV et une courte lettre de motivation. Sachez que l’anglais est la langue de notre entreprise et certains de nos entretiens se dérouleront en anglais. Nous avons hâte de faire votre connaissance !

description:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, https://www.trustpilot.com/review/qonto.com based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture https://qonto.com/en/careers/culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here https://medium.com/qonto-way/the-qonto-way-our-culture-is-our-strategy-90defd4895f9).

 

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre https://www.linkedin.com/in/aprot/ and Steve https://www.linkedin.com/in/steveanavi/, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

 

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process https://medium.com/qonto-way/a-recruiters-dilemma-confronting-bias-in-hiring-b78acce148eb because the best teams are built on merit.

 

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here https://medium.com/qonto-way/ai-at-qonto-vision-statement-725a7e2f659b) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.



Join us as a Social Media Working Student and help Qonto build its presence wherever our customers engage. You’ll create content that captures attention, work on creator and event activations, and shape the social formats we test next. You’ll work directly with Beate from our Social Media team, under the guidance of Laura Günder, Head of Marketing Central Europe.




What you’d be part of

2026, a few projects we ran:

 - Accelerated by Qonto: A pop-up store in Berlin Mitte where young founders get a week each to show their products. In October, four female-founded brands won a week, with an opening party, a female health and supplements program, and breathwork and yoga sessions.

 - Events across Germany: Bits & Pretzels in Munich (including a founders hike), OMR in Hamburg (including female founder side events), and more.

 - Ambassador campaign (December): We’re teaming up with a major German influencer and founder of one of the country’s most successful fashion brands. Who it is stays secret for now ;)

2027, a glimpse of what’s coming: a Qonto truck at CSD Berlin with influencer and podcast collaborations, new social-first brand activations (we’d love your ideas), many more events, and new social formats to test.





➡️ What you’ll do

 - Create social content: Write copy, design graphics and produce short-form video, including on-camera appearances, using a clear hook-story-CTA structure.

 - Scout creators and customers: Find influencers and Qonto customers worth featuring, based on reach, niche and brand fit.

 - Amplify events: Produce content before, during and after events and run giveaways or raffles.

 - Keep our presence alive: Monitor competitors and manage community interactions.

 - Bring your own ideas: Pitch new formats and social-first activations for us to test.
   
   

➡️ What we’re looking for

 - Fluent German and strong English: you write copy that resonates with German SMEs and communicate comfortably in English.

 - A Master’s in Communication, Media, Business or a related field, with 1 to 2 years of study remaining.

 - Experience creating content in front of and behind the camera, so it feels authentic.

 - Strong organizational skills: you keep events, creator collaborations and giveaways on track with several people involved.

 - Comfort with AI tools for content creation, research or reporting.
   
   
   
   

➡️ What we can offer you

 - Direct ownership: from scripting a creator video to running an event giveaway, your work reaches our audience.

 - Real projects: pop-ups, festivals, creator collaborations and campaigns with real visibility.

 - Creative input: your ideas for 2027 will be heard.

 - Real opportunities to build an on-camera presence, if that interests you.
   
   
   
   

➡️ Your future manager
You’ll report to Laura Günder https://www.linkedin.com/in/laura-g%C3%BCnder-63339562/, our Head of Marketing Central Europe. Laura has 8 years of experience scaling marketing at fast-growing tech and fintech companies. She grew Doctolib’s marketing from B2B through brand and product positioning, and led Helpling’s marketing across several European markets. She has a track record of scaling teams and building sustainable growth in competitive markets, and offers hands-on coaching rather than distant oversight.




Perks

 - Flexible hybrid work: up to 2 days per week from home.

 - Gympass: access to 50+ sport and wellness partners.

 - Meal card: up to €100 per month on us.

 - Public transport ticket: 100% covered.

 - Team events, snacks and drinks.

 - An inclusive, supportive environment where everyone is welcome.


[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.



[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here https://qonto.com/en/careers/candidate-journey



[DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice https://qonto.com/en/legal-documents/privacy-notice for full details.

description: About Invesco As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco. What’s in it for you? Our people are at the very core of our success. Invesco employees get more out of life through our benefit and perk offerings including: Company networking events with other interns Peer Sponsor Program Leadership Connection series Virtual Lunch and Learns Invesco Cares volunteer events Complimentary coffee and snacks 401(K) matching of 100% up to the first 6% with a discretionary supplemental contribution Job Description Early Career Intern - Legal, Compliance, Audit & Risk (LCAR) Overview Ready to make your mark in the world of asset management? Spend an unforgettable summer at Invesco alongside a select group of driven students. Our 9-week Summer Internship Program kicks off in June 2027 and offers you the chance to dive into the fast-paced world of investments, learn from industry pros, and build connections that will last a lifetime. In this internship, you’ll get hands-on experience, one-on-one mentorship, and the inside scoop on what it’s really like to work at a global investment firm. As part of a Summer Internship Program cohort, you will have a variety of initiatives to keep you engaged throughout the summer including orientation, networking events, development workshops, and volunteer activities. You’ll work side-by-side with talented teams to learn about the business. Here’s the best part: crush your internship, and you could be eligible for a full-time offer to join our Early Career Program after graduation! Your Role LCAR plays a key role in supporting Invesco’s strategic and operational goals. As an Early Career LCAR Intern, you will support critical functions that protect and guide the firm, assisting with initiatives such as legal research, regulatory assessments, compliance monitoring, and internal audits. description: FP&A Intern Team description SumUp Next is more than an internship programme, it's the entry point to building a career in a global fintech. Created as a genuine starting point within the SumUp ecosystem, the programme is designed for high potential students who want to learn by doing, take on responsibility early, and create real impact on the business. As an FP&A Strategy Intern, you'll join Corporate FP&A, SumUp's internal strategy and finance partner to business leaders, the team that turns data into the decisions that move the business. From day one, you'll support real analyses that feed into capital allocation, reporting strategy, and investor relations, learning how financial and strategic decisions come together at SumUp. We believe growth happens through practice, with autonomy, support, and room to experiment. Our goal is for every intern to finish the programme ready for what's next, with the skills, mindset, and experience to continue their journey as a SumUpper. If you want to build your career in finance and strategy in a global, dynamic environment, SumUp Next was made for you. Take a look inside our São Paulo office You'll be great for this role if Currently pursuing a degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Engineering, or another quantitative field, with graduation expected by 2028, and living in Santiago or the surrounding area You show a structured, hypothesis driven approach to problem solving, with the ability to turn ambiguous questions into clear, data backed recommendations A first taste of analytical work, for example through personal, volunteering, or academic projects in strategy, finance, or a related field Demonstrated skills in Excel or Google Sheets, with curiosity about tools like Apps Script or Python, to help us build financial models Advanced English proficiency to communicate with a range of global stakeholders Differentiators we're excited about Proficiency in Google Slides or PowerPoint, with an interest in turning analysis into clear narratives Participation in case competitions, academic leagues, junior enterprises, research projects, or entrepreneurial initiatives An analytical, organised profile with strong attention to detail What you can learn in our internship programme Work on real finance and strategy problems, helping build the models that support capital allocation decisions and long term planning Collaborate with different teams to support cross-functional strategy projects, from pricing to cost efficiency initiatives Help build and maintain KPIs, dashboards, and performance frameworks, developing a data driven view of the business Support the development of business cases and investment cases for new initiatives, learning how to turn analysis into clear narratives Gain autonomy to propose ideas and contribute to the automation of analytical workflows Why you should join SumUp 🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Santiago office. This involves an office-first setup 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp’s future success 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget that you can use to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education 🏖️ Generous time off: 20 days of paid leave, plus public holidays and special leave days 🏥 Health and life coverage: in partnership with Zurich, we offer health insurance, including optical and dental and life insurance 💻 Extra allowances: tax-free support for meals, childcare, transportation, and home internet 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team About SumUp Be empowered to do more that matters. At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 39 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships. Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 4,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. description:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, https://www.trustpilot.com/review/qonto.com based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture https://qonto.com/en/careers/culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here https://medium.com/qonto-way/the-qonto-way-our-culture-is-our-strategy-90defd4895f9).

 

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre https://www.linkedin.com/in/aprot/ and Steve https://www.linkedin.com/in/steveanavi/, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

 

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process https://medium.com/qonto-way/a-recruiters-dilemma-confronting-bias-in-hiring-b78acce148eb because the best teams are built on merit.

 

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here https://medium.com/qonto-way/ai-at-qonto-vision-statement-725a7e2f659b) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

 



Join us as a Product Operations Intern and help a team of 2 keep an organization of ~80 Product Managers running like clockwork — from OKR reporting to provider management. You'll own recurring work that directly feeds product leadership decisions, under the guidance of Mario Liverini https://www.linkedin.com/in/mario-liverini/, our Product Operations Manager.



➡️ What you'll do

 - Own Product reporting end-to-end: Produce and maintain OKR recaps and Monthly Business Reviews that product leadership relies on every month.

 - Drive high-visibility projects: Take on competitor database cleanups, AI tools inventories, or tooling documentation — work that PMs actually use.

 - Use AI to move faster: Automate repetitive tasks, sharpen documentation, and find smarter ways for the team to operate.

 - Keep our provider costs clean: Cross-check supplier invoices against contracts, flag discrepancies, and maintain internal spend tracking.
   
   

➡️ What we're looking for

 - Detail-obsessed: You catch inconsistencies before anyone else does and your output needs minimal editing.

 - Clear written communicator: You document precisely and produce reporting artifacts that are sharp and self-explanatory.

 - Comfortable owning recurring work: You take pride in being the reliable point of contact for a process, month after month.

 - Fluent in Google Sheets and Notion: You work in these tools daily and either know them well or learn fast.

 - AI-native: You experiment with AI tools, have a deep understanding of LLMs, automate what you can, and enjoy finding smarter ways to work.
   
   

➡️ What you'll get

 - Real ownership from month 2-3: Once ramped, you run reporting, provider management, and side projects autonomously — no hand-holding.

 - Visibility at the top: Your work reaches company leadership every single month.

 - A small team where impact is immediate: Three people means fast feedback, direct learning, and nothing to hide behind.

 - Projects that outlast your internship: From AI tool inventories to competitor databases, you'll leave something behind that the team keeps using.
   
   

➡️ Your future manager

You'll report to Mario Liverini https://www.linkedin.com/in/mario-liverini/, Product Operations Manager at Qonto. Mario sets clear expectations from day one and gives you real autonomy once you're up to speed. If you find a faster or smarter way to get something done — especially with AI — that's not just tolerated: it's the point.

At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn't just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick! Who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we've been searching for all along.



Perks

 - Flex your schedule. Work from home up to 2 days a week with our hybrid policy.

 - Stay active. Gympass gives you access to 3,000+ sports and wellness partners.

 - Eat well. Lunch card, 50% on us.

 - Get around. 50% of the cost of your public transportation pass is covered.

 - Enjoy the rest. Team events, snacks, and beverages.

 - Take time off. 1 paid day off per month, no questions asked.

 - Be yourself. An inclusive, supportive environment where everyone belongs.




[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.



[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here https://qonto.com/en/careers/candidate-journey



[DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice https://qonto.com/en/legal-documents/privacy-notice for full details.

description: Department : Flexible role within Investor Relations Department Location : Frankfurt Contract : Internship Duration : 3 to 6 months Start date : June 2027 The role The Frankfurt-based internship will involve contributing to various key tasks: Fundraising support: Develop tailor-made presentations to meet the needs of our major clients. Generate financial data for prospective investors' due diligence, including historical and projected cash flows, performance indicators, and financial metrics evolution. Update marketing sets for fundraising efforts, including Excel due diligence packs, marketing presentations, and PPM. Conduct portfolio modelling and investment simulations in new funds. Investor reporting: Provide detailed and technical responses to investors on quantitative and qualitative data included in reports, communications, or any developments regarding the company/funds' activities. Produce tailor-made transversal reporting that covers historical and projected performance, portfolio diversification, and investment simulations, ensuring accuracy and relevance to investors' needs. Additional analyses: Assist in mapping the investor landscape and identifying potential LPs, leveraging internal and external databases. Gather information on regional financial news to support investor communications. Help prepare and coordinate information campaigns to investors, ensuring clear and impactful communication of key messages and developments. Required skills Fluent in both English and German. Advanced proficiency in Excel and a good command of other Microsoft Office applications. Sound understanding of Corporate and Private Equity fund financial models. Exceptional attention to detail. Self-motivated with the ability to work independently on projects. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within a team. Profile Final year undergraduate or graduate level student in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Business Management or equivalent. Commercial understanding of Private Equity. Ideally, you already have initial experience through internships in similar areas. About the Team The Investor Relations Department is responsible for fundraising activities and managing relationships with existing investors. It also coordinates with all teams within Ardian to respond to investors’ due diligence questions. This collaboration ensures that all team members have a thorough understanding of Ardian's full scope of operations. This knowledge allows them to deliver services that maintain Ardian's reputation. The Investor Relations Department comprises three teams: Sales Force, Client Solutions, and Product Management. The Client Solutions Team, consisting of over 20 professionals, operates across New York, Paris, London, Frankfurt, Santiago, Singapore, Beijing and Tokyo. This team's primary focus is addressing investors' inquiries, delivering both standard and customized reports promptly and to the highest standards, covering Ardian’s extensive investment activities. Team members, with their strong quantitative backgrounds, are responsible for managing data to respond to both current and prospective investors' inquiries.
