The required internship duration is at least 4 months or longer. The Role Ardian’s Buyout team is excited to offer an internship opportunity in the Frankfurt office, designed to provide hands-on experience in identifying, analyzing, and executing investments. As an intern, you will play a key role from day one, becoming an integral part of a supportive, collaborative, and dynamic team. This role offers a unique opportunity to work closely with experienced investment professionals, support functions, and external industry experts. Ardian has a strong track record of mentoring our interns and provide a environment for growth. Many of our previous interns have gone on to secure permanent roles within the Buyout team. Key Responsibilities An intern at Ardian Buyout will be actively involved in a variety of tasks, with tailored guidance and support to ensure professional growth and learning. Such responsibilities include: Research target companies, competitors, and industries while contributing to discussions with experts. Assess investment opportunities through business analysis, financial modeling, and valuation. Support the investment process by drafting memoranda and reviewing due diligence. Monitor portfolio companies and assist with exit strategies. Please note, this list is not exhaustive; responsibilities will be adapted to your strengths and the team’s needs. What We’re Looking For At Ardian, we value diverse perspectives and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. This role requires a combination of analytical skills, intellectual curiosity, and teamwork. Key Skills: A broad set of quantitative, qualitative, and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative, team-oriented mindset. Strong organizational abilities and adaptability to thrive in a dynamic, supportive environment. High level of attention to detail and a desire to develop problem-solving skills through hands-on experience. Proficiency in financial statement analysis, financial modeling, and valuation techniques. Familiarity with Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Your Profile: We’re looking for candidates who: Are currently enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s program at a leading business school or university. Have an excellent academic record. Possess previous internship experience in any of the following fields (preferred but not mandatory): Private Equity Investment Banking (M&A, Leveraged Finance) Transaction Services Strategy Consulting Are fluent in both German and English. If you are passionate about investment, eager to learn, and thrive in a collaborative environment, we encourage you to apply. About Ardian’s Buyout Team The Buyout activity is active across the globe with offices in Paris, Frankfurt, Milan, Madrid, Luxembourg, London, and New York. With US$16bn of assets under management, the team focuses on transformational buy-and-build strategies that help regional champions evolve into global leaders. Our multinational team of 52 investment professionals has built expertise in industries such as healthcare, technology, food value chains, and services. At Ardian, we believe in empowering talented individuals from all backgrounds to achieve their career aspirations while contributing to meaningful, impactful work. Application process Please send your high school diploma (incl. grades), your bachelor / master (intermediate) certificates and your references from all your internships by clicking on APPLY. Incomplete applications cannot be taken into consideration. Kindly also specify your desired internship period and duration. The required internship duration is at least 4 months or longer. There, you will gain access to a wide range of advice, preparatory materials, and testimonials.

description: Ready to take the next step in your career and make your mark in the financial world? At Vontobel, we believe diverse perspectives drive innovation and success. That’s why we’re excited to welcome passionate, ambitious, and curious students into our Early Careers Internship Program. Whether you’re fascinated by Risk Management or Change Management this program offers you the chance to collaborate with a dynamic team, receive personalized support, and contribute to projects that truly matter. Over 6 months, starting on 1 March 2027, you’ll gain hands-on experience and insights into the financial industry while building lasting connections in a globally recognized investment firm. What would your role be? As part of the internship, you will: Dashboard Development & Reporting: You will support the creation, maintenance and enhancement of Power BI dashboards to visualise key risk metrics, indicators and reporting information across different financial risk departments. Data Management & Quality: You will collect, clean, structure and validate data from different sources to ensure accuracy, consistency and reliability in risk reporting. Project Management Support: You will support the coordination of initiatives across financial risk departments, including tracking deliverables, consolidating updates, maintaining documentation and following up on action items. Cross-Functional Collaboration: You will work with colleagues across different financial risk departments to understand reporting needs, gather relevant information and develop clear, consistent and user-friendly reporting materials. What are we looking for? What you bring We are seeking highly motivated students that share our values : Ownership : You are curious and get involved. You ask why a process works the way it does, offer to help where your team needs it, and see your own projects through from start to finish. Tenacity : You are driven and self-dependent. When the data doesn’t add up or the first approach fails, you look for another way and you come back with an answer. Foresight : You are a pro-active self-starter with a can-do mentality. You spot what’s coming and you take the initiative to solve it before it becomes a problem. What sets you apart AI literacy : You use AI tools to research, analyze and draft faster, and you double-check their output before you rely on it. Collaboration: You work well with others and build your network. You reach out to colleagues beyond your own team, learn how other parts of the bank work, and share what you find. What you need to apply You are enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program, or graduated within the last two years, in finance, technology or a related field. You have a genuine interest in the financial sector. You are fluent in English, written and spoken. German, French or Italian is a plus. You hold a valid work permit for the location you are applying to. What do we offer? At Vontobel, we strive to create an inspiring environment where you can thrive. Here’s what you can expect: Prime Zurich location: Modern collaboration spaces, and free on-site canteen offering freshly prepared lunches to keep you energized. Supportive and inclusive culture: Be part of a friendly, diverse team that values individuality and collaboration in an open-office setting. Tools for success: Access the latest technology and resources to excel in your role. Networking opportunities: join our NextGen community and meet other interns for lunch. Flat hierarchy and innovation: Collaborate at all levels and contribute to exciting projects in an agile, future-focused work environment. Paid internship: we offer standardized salary for all early career interns including free lunch. The application period for the 2027 Early Careers Internship Program runs from 5 to 15 November . description:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.




About the role:
As a Brokerage Operations Intern you will dive into the fast-paced world of capital markets. You will support our Brokerage Managers in daily trading activities, risk management, order monitoring, and the operational rollout of exciting new investment products. This is a unique opportunity to learn the intricacies of trade execution, algorithmic trading, and investment management from industry experts.



WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Order Management & Best Execution: Support the daily monitoring of trade executions and order flows to help ensure client trades are processed accurately, on time, and in strict adherence to best execution policies.

 - Risk Management & Algorithmic Trading Support: Assist the team in monitoring algorithmic trading flows and evaluating daily operational risks, helping to ensure our automated trading systems run smoothly and within defined risk parameters.

 - Market Abuse Monitoring & Compliance: Support the continuous monitoring of trading activities to assist in identifying potential market abuse scenarios. Help prepare data for regulatory compliance reporting (such as MiFIR, MAR, or Best Execution).

 - Investment Universe Management: Assist in managing and expanding our offered investment universe across various European and EMEA jurisdictions, ensuring new and existing assets align with local regulatory and operational requirements.

 - Trade Execution Support: Assist with the daily operational processes surrounding trading, including the execution handling for equities, mutual funds, and ELTIFs (European Long-Term Investment Funds).

 - Product Planning & Launch: Collaborate cross-functionally with Product and Operations teams to assist with research and operational readiness for new brokerage product launches across different regions.

 - Ad-Hoc Brokerage Projects: Actively participate in team projects aimed at improving execution mechanisms, rectifying mistrades, and optimizing our internal trading infrastructure.

 


WHAT YOU BRING:

 - Keen Interest in Markets & Data: A strong, demonstrable passion for financial markets, data analysis, trading, and the fintech ecosystem.

 - Foundational Knowledge: Basic understanding of market structures, trade lifecycles, and different financial instruments (knowledge of mutual funds, ELTIFs, or algorithmic trading concepts is a great bonus!).

 - Analytical Mindset: High attention to detail, excellent problem-solving skills, and a proactive, "hands-on" attitude when dealing with complex data.

 - Tech-Savvy: Comfortable working with data and eager to learn about trading platforms, market data tools (like Bloomberg), and internal order management systems.

 - Communication: Fluency in English is required; German is a strong plus.

 


HOW WE UPVEST IN YOU:

 - Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

 - Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

 - Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

 


OUR VALUES:

 - Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

 - Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

 - Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

 - Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

description: About Invesco As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco. What’s in it for you? Our people are at the very core of our success. Invesco employees get more out of life through our benefit and perk offerings including: Company networking events with other interns Peer Sponsor Program Leadership Connection series Virtual Lunch and Learns Invesco Cares volunteer events Complimentary coffee and snacks 401(K) matching of 100% up to the first 6% with a discretionary supplemental contribution Job Description Ready to make your mark in the world of asset management? Spend an unforgettable summer at Invesco alongside a select group of high performing students. Our 9-week Summer Internship Program, kicking off in June 2027, offers you the opportunity to delve into the dynamic world of client services within a global investment firm. You’ll learn from seasoned professionals, gain hands-on experience, and build lasting connections. As part of our Summer Internship Program cohort, you’ll participate in orientation, networking events, development workshops, and volunteer activities. description:
About Ledger

We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.




The team

The Consolidation team, part of Finance (Accounting & Consolidation), prepares the Group’s IFRS consolidated financial statements across multiple international legal entities. The team is moving its consolidation EPM tool from SAP BFC (ViaReport C&R) to Amelkis EPM, with a go-live targeted for Q1 2027, while preparing the 2026 annual closing. The intern supports both work streams and reports to the Consolidation Director.



What you’ll be doing:

Annual consolidation closing (2026)

 - Support the preparation of the Group’s IFRS consolidated financial statements across multiple legal entities

 - Assist with intercompany reconciliation and eliminations

 - Process consolidation adjustments and review reporting packages submitted by subsidiaries

 - Liaise with subsidiary finance teams to collect, control and consolidate reporting packages

 - Support ad hoc analyses requested during the annual audit



EPM tool migration (SAP BFC to Amelkis EPM)

 - Contribute to data migration, configuration and testing workshops for the new Amelkis consolidation/EPM tool

 - Participate in the “double run” phase to ensure data accuracy between the legacy and new systems

 - Help document consolidation processes and procedures throughout the tool transition



What we’re looking for:

 - Master’s-level student (Bac+4/5) in Accounting, Finance or Audit (DSCG, Master CCA, business or engineering school), looking for a gap year (césure) or an end-of-studies internship

 - First experience with, or strong interest in, consolidation and IFRS (previous internship, audit firm exposure or dedicated coursework)

 - Comfortable working with large data sets and advanced Excel functions

 - Curiosity for finance systems and tools (EPM, SAP BFC, Amelkis EPM) is a strong plus

 - Fluent in English and French (the team reports bilingually)

 - Rigorous and structured



What the internship offers

 - Hands-on exposure to IFRS consolidation in a fast-growing, international tech group

 - Active involvement in a live EPM tool migration (SAP BFC to Amelkis EPM), a skill highly valued in the finance job market

 - Close mentoring from the Consolidation Director and the wider accounting team



For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information.

We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

description: Ready to take the next step in your career and make your mark in the financial world? At Vontobel, we believe diverse perspectives drive innovation and success. That’s why we’re excited to welcome passionate, ambitious, and curious students into our Early Careers Internship Program. If you are fascinated by finance, business performance, and how strategic decisions translate into financial results, this program offers you the chance to collaborate with dynamic Group and Business Controlling teams, receive personalized support, and contribute to work that creates tangible value for the business and our shareholders. Over 6 months, starting on 1 March 2027, you’ll gain hands-on experience and insights into the financial industry while building lasting connections in a globally recognized investment firm. What would your role be? As part of the internship, you will: Gain first-hand experience in Finance Business Partnering and understand how Finance supports business decision-making. Develop an understanding of the Bank’s key businesses, including Private Clients, Institutional Clients & Investments, and Structured Solutions. Contribute to management reporting and performance analysis, developing an understanding of key business and financial drivers. Participate in forecasting and planning processes, from business assumptions to financial outcomes. Gain hands-on experience with Finance systems and reporting tools, including Power BI and SAP. Build your banking and finance knowledge through practical experience, collaboration, and networking. What are we looking for? What you bring We are seeking highly motivated students that share our values : Ownership : You are curious and get involved. You ask why a process works the way it does, offer to help where your team needs it, and see your own projects through from start to finish. Tenacity : You are driven and self-dependent. When the data doesn’t add up or the first approach fails, you look for another way and you come back with an answer. Foresight : You are a pro-active self-starter with a can-do mentality. You spot what’s coming and you take the initiative to solve it before it becomes a problem. What sets you apart AI literacy : You use AI tools to research, analyze and draft faster, and you double-check their output before you rely on it. Collaboration: You work well with others and build your network. You reach out to colleagues beyond your own team, learn how other parts of the bank work, and share what you find. What you need to apply You are enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program, or graduated within the last two years, in finance, accounting, controlling, business administration, economics, or a related field. You have a genuine interest in the financial sector. You are fluent in English, written and spoken. German, French or Italian is a plus. You hold a valid work permit for the location you are applying to. What do we offer? At Vontobel, we strive to create an inspiring environment where you can thrive. Here’s what you can expect: Prime Zurich location: Modern collaboration spaces, and free on-site canteen offering freshly prepared lunches to keep you energized. Supportive and inclusive culture: Be part of a friendly, diverse team that values individuality and collaboration in an open-office setting. Tools for success: Access the latest technology and resources to excel in your role. · Networking opportunities: join our NextGen community and meet other interns for lunch. Flat hierarchy and innovation: Collaborate at all levels and contribute to exciting projects in an agile, future-focused work environment. Paid internship: we offer standardized salary for all early career interns including free lunch. The application period for the 2027 Early Careers Internship Program runs from 5 to 15 November . As applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and positions may close early, we encourage you to apply early. You may submit a maximum of two applications across all internship positions. Why Vontobel? At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 29 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability. Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role. Do you want to be Vontobel? Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner. At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination. If you have any questions you can contact us through our contact form .

description: As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco. Job Description Your role: We are looking for our next Intern in the Quantitative Research for a minimum of 6 months based in Frankfurt am Main ! During this internship, you'll support the quantitative investment research by combining rigorous statistical methods with modern machine learning and responsible AI tools to improve research efficiency, portfolio insights, and investment outcomes. Key Responsibilities: Develop and improve quantitative and factor-based investment strategies for institutional and retail clients globally. Investigate tools, techniques, and metrics, including appropriate AI-assisted methods, that can provide deeper portfolio insight and improve client outcomes. Prepare, validate, and analyze financial and alternative datasets; use AI-enabled workflows where appropriate while maintaining data quality, reproducibility, and confidentiality. Participate in the development and evolution of alpha signals, portfolio construction, and risk-management approaches. Perform thorough research and statistical analysis for strategy development and ongoing management, with robust out-of-sample testing and clear documentation. Contribute to exploratory projects that apply machine learning or generative AI to quantitative research and workflow improvement, with guidance from senior researchers. Ensure all activities are in line with Invesco's Conduct principles and applicable governance for data, models, intellectual property, and responsible AI use. You'll need to have: Experience working with SQL and cloud-based environments such as AWS is a plus. Excellent working knowledge of econometrics and statistics, including time-series analysis. Exposure to machine learning or generative AI through coursework, research projects, or previous experience is a plus. Experience with financial databases such as Compustat, Worldscope, or Datastream, and risk and optimization tools such as Axioma or Barra, is beneficial. Very strong analytical and mathematical skills, including optimization techniques. Good coding skills, preferably in Python or R; familiarity with Git and reproducible research practices is desirable. Basic understanding of machine-learning concepts and an interest in applying AI techniques to quantitative investment research. Familiarity with modern AI tools, including generative AI and coding assistants, and an ability to use them critically and responsibly. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical methods clearly. Working towards an advanced degree in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, computer science, data science, applied mathematics, physics, or a related discipline. Excellent academic background with demonstrated strength in quantitative coursework or research. Evidence of applied problem-solving through coursework, research projects, competitions, or relevant internships is valued. Highly motivated and able to collaborate across groups while remaining focused on high-quality research execution. Curious and pragmatic about emerging technology, with sound judgment regarding where AI adds value and where human review remains essential. Ability to communicate effectively with quantitative researchers, portfolio managers, client portfolio managers, distribution teams, intermediaries, and clients. Passion for quantitative, research-driven investment management; results-oriented and a dependable teammate. Full Time / Part Time Full time Worker Type Student/Intern (Fixed Term) Job Exempt (Yes / No) Yes Workplace Model Pursuant to Invesco’s Workplace Policy, employees are expected to comply with the firm’s most current workplace model, which as of October 1, 2025, includes spending at least four full days each week working in the role's advertised office. This reflects our belief that spending time together in the office helps us build stronger relationships, collaborate more easily, and support each other’s growth and development. If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you! We want all of our candidates to shine during the application and selection process, so if you need any adjustments to be made, please send an e-mail to emea-talentacquisition@invesco.com. Please include your name, the job you are interested in, and the type of adjustment you need (for example; breaks during your interview, remote interviews, additional time for assessments or other required adjustments) We promote a working environment that welcomes everyone and creates inclusive teams, celebrates difference and encourages everyone to be themselves at work. Our commitment to the community and environmental, social and governance investing: We partner with charitable organisations globally to make an impact in the communities where we live and work. Our people are encouraged to support the charities they feel most passionate about. We are also committed to environmental, social and governance (ESG) investing. We serve our clients in this space as a trusted partner both on specific responsible investment product strategies as well as part of our commitment to deliver a superior investment experience. Recruitment Agencies: Invesco has an in-house recruitment team, which focuses on sourcing great candidates directly. Invesco will not accept unsolicited resumes from agency or search firm recruiters. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired. When we do use agencies, we have a PSL in place, so please do not contact hiring

description:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As we enter our next phase of growth, we're looking for a driven Growth Intern to join our team for the summer. You'll work directly within the Growth team, sitting at the intersection of Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and Revenue Operations. This is a hands-on role with real responsibility.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - AI and process automation - lead AI efforts to improve sales efficiency via automations and work with state-of-the-art technology (claude code / cowork, n8n, etc.)

 - Deal support - help AEs on strategic deals via pre meeting and project assistance

 - Support outbound sales motions - contribute to developing outbound strategies and help craft pitches that resonate with banks, wealth managers, and fintech clients

 - Drive data-driven insights - run analyses on pipeline and sales performance to identify where we should focus, and help turn those findings into concrete initiatives

 - Lead market research - independently research the competitive landscape, identify new business opportunities, and surface trends that inform our GTM strategy

 - Support us on business development - work closely with Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and Product to support and align on strategic priorities

 - Contribute to sales enablement - help build materials and processes that make the AE team more effective




WHAT YOU BRING:

 - Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's programme (Business, Finance, Economics, or related field)

 - Strong analytical mindset - comfortable working with data and drawing actionable conclusions

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; German is a strong plus

 - Genuine interest in financial services, investment infrastructure, or B2B SaaS

 - Self-starter attitude - you take ownership and don't wait to be told what to do

 - Previous experience in a fast-paced environment (finance, consulting, startups) is a plus




WHAT YOU'LL GET:

 - Direct exposure to a high-growth fintech building Europe's investment infrastructure

 - Mentorship from experienced GTM professionals

 - Real ownership of projects that matter

 - A competitive internship stipend

 - The full Upvest culture - feedback, autonomy, and a team that genuinely enjoys working together




HOW WE UPVEST IN YOU:

 - Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

 - Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

 - Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem Black at Upvest, Up&Out, and UpVergent.




OUR VALUES:

 - Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

 - Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

 - Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

 - Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

description: We are global private markets specialists delivering tailored investment solutions, advisory services, and impactful, data driven insights to the world’s investors.  - Support payment and credit compliance: You’ll help analyse payment and credit rules to ensure compliance of new features, client claims, account suspensions and T&Cs changes to protect our customers.

 - Act as an internal counsel: You’ll interpret legal texts from different European countries and explain complex constraints to non-legal teams, using AI tools to speed up your research.

 - Lend a hand on ad-hoc missions: You’ll support evolving priorities such as our credit license transition and jump in on 1–2 day missions for other regulatory sub-teams.

➡️ What we’re looking for

 - Relevant studies: You’re ideally in a Master 2 in banking law, compliance, data protection or business law.

 - Legal comprehension: You can read legal texts from various European countries and grasp their core logic.

 - Triage mindset: You can sort a large volume of daily alerts and spot what truly matters for Qonto.

 - Clear communicator: You’re fluent in English and explain legal conclusions simply to non-legal teams, and French is a plus.

 - AI-fluent: You use AI tools to work faster and always double-check the output.

➡️ What we can offer you

You’ll report to Edouard Cahen https://www.linkedin.com/in/edouard-cahen-a48654109/, Head of Regulatory Compliance. Edouard has 8 years of experience in banking and fintech regulatory compliance, both in law firms and in-house. As a manager, he emphasizes rigor, independence and clear communication.

We're looking for a Regional Marketing Intern - Italy to be a crucial force in driving our growth in the Italian market. Your creative and skilled approach will directly support and realize impactful marketing campaigns and local initiatives that matter to this region.

This is a chance to leave your mark by supporting creative and strategic campaigns and executing high-value events and content. You'll connect the dots between regional marketing, partner marketing, sales, customer success, product marketing and design, gaining first-hand experience in a fast-moving fintech company, right at the heart of Milan.

If you're ready to jump in, own key projects, and see your efforts translate into tangible results for our growth in Italy, this is your mission.

 - End-to-End Project & Event Management: Independently manage and execute your own projects and regional event logistics from conception to analysis, utilizing our systems to build localized content hubs, deploy full-funnel email campaigns, and execute targeted Account-Based Marketing (ABM) initiatives.

What you'll bring

 - Currently studying in marketing, business administration, communication, or a similar field.

 - Fluency in Italian and business proficiency in English to thrive in an international environment (French is a big plus).

 - A proactive, creative, and results-driven attitude.

 - Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

 - Familiarity with the Italian market.

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie https://jobs.mollie.com/ is really like.

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings https://jobs.mollie.com/ai-manifesto that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.
